skill_geometry_band.source_anchor: persistent block-chance buff that returns a lightning chain to attackers on each successful block; the returned zap is a defensive-proc consequence, not a targeted offensive geometry
the kit is delivery-agnostic — any offense sits atop the block engine; single_target placeholder for the on-block Retaliation payload. Offense identity is subordinate to the defensive loop
rains a volley of blades that linger on the ground; in engine terms a multi_projectile placement that seeds the summon source — the lingering blades are the ammunition substrate

animates each lingering blade into a transient ranged sword-minion (proxy) that fires projectiles dealing poison; the proxy is the dominant every-3-seconds damage source. totem geometry = placed autonomous proxy entity

bolt reaches from caster to a target then hops enemy-to-enemy across the pack; per-chain damage growth (+15% more per remaining chain) is a native chain-geometry scaling property; shock (PoE damage-amp) maps to sunder — guaranteed via the Shaper-of-Storms variant, chance-based on the base skill

slow orb drifts and zaps a small AoE every 150ms; Archmage adds flat lightning = % of unreserved mana on each cast. Modeled as a tick-AoE (circle) around the orb's dwell point; the projectile-drift itself is not a distinct 26-type. Shock->sunder from the lightning damage. Manabond variant is a line hit (line geometry) — same resource identity

brand is applied as a mark on a nearby enemy; while attached it periodically drops a meteor (small-radius fire AoE) at the marked enemy's position while the player moves freely. Meteor = ground_targeted_circle at the mark's location. Shaper-of-Flames variant guarantees ignite -> burn
recalls all active brands to the player and immediately re-attaches them to nearby enemies — a mark-relocation utility, not an offensive geometry; blink used as the reposition-of-marks utility handle

10-16 persistent auras radiating from the player body; in the source these buff ALLIES within radius (Generosity shares to allies, not self). In solo scope there are no allies to receive them — the ally-projection is the un-mappable core
near-zero-damage token attack the player presses occasionally; not the kit's point

a dozen-plus persistent auras radiating from the player, buffing the PLAYER themselves (solo self-recipient); stacked aura-effect (cluster jewels) multiplies offense and defense simultaneously. water/cold family via Call-of-the-Brotherhood lightning->cold conversion; the auras ARE the offense — no active attack in the core loop

the player's ONLY active input — charge through a pack; crits freeze an enemy, and the freezing kill seeds the Herald-of-Ice shatter. Movement IS the damage trigger. water/cold family; freeze native with shatter payoff

skill_geometry_band.source_skill: Herald of Ice + Inpulsa's Broken Heart (on-kill explosion chain)
skill_geometry_band.source_anchor: HoI shatters cold-killed enemies (cold burst); Inpulsa makes SHOCKED killed enemies explode for lightning, and each explosion-kill chains to the next — a self-propagating on-kill cascade. ring = burst-around-the-killed-enemy. shock(->sunder) is the Inpulsa trigger-gate. This is autonomous — no button press

slow orb drifts forward zapping a small AoE every 150ms; slower orb = more hits per target (inverse-velocity). Deployed via mines (throw + detonate) in the Saboteur variant. Modeled as a circle tick-AoE around the orb's dwell; the drift + inverse-velocity is a behavioral property the geometry enum doesn't carry. shock->sunder; Saboteur 'Born in the Shadows' grants blind

one cast applies a chaos DoT (drain) in a small area AND every linked hex-curse simultaneously to the same enemies; more curses applied = more Bane damage (per-curse multiplier). shadow family (chaos drain-DoT lineage). Bundled curses: Despair->curse:amplify (chaos-res-reduction hex), Enfeeble->curse:weaken, Temporal Chains->curse:decrepify

summon zombies at corpse locations; they fight autonomously with slam attacks (ground_slam per-zombie AoE, ~17-unit radius). The Baron helm converts player STRENGTH into army size (+1 zombie/500 STR) and power (half player STR -> minions). Physical melee proxies — element-neutral (physical rule); flavor only. Player positioning is passive

channel to accumulate up to 6 stages (each +25% more damage); on release, detonate the stored stages in one burst (extra hit per stage). Self-origin frontal close-range AoE (dossier: 'circle in front of player', small radius) -> melee_arc (wide frontal melee) is the closest 26-type. Rooted while channelling. Physical melee -> element-neutral (physical rule); Voidheart ring applies poison + bleed on hit

volley of blades rains at the target location and LEAVES lingering blade-entities stuck in the ground; multi_projectile placement whose real function is seeding a persistent blade-field (the detonation fuel), not the impact damage. physical origin -> no element family (crosswalk physical rule); flavor-neutral

detonates every lingering blade in an explosion-per-blade; each detonation marks further blades for a propagating chain of explosions across the field (up to 30 detonations/s). ring = burst-around-each-blade; the dominant every-3s damage is the field-detonation cascade. Profane Bloom (Occultist) adds cursed-death explosion-chaining atop it

skill_geometry_band.source_skill: Blood Magic (keystone passive — no active cast)
skill_geometry_band.source_anchor: NOT an active skill with a discrete geometry — a keystone that rewrites the resource chassis for EVERY skill. self_buff is a degenerate placeholder; the kit's whole expression is in resource_economy, not geometry. element-neutral (physical/chaos raw is incidental; keystone is element-agnostic)

melee strike whose impact radiates a small shockwave from the hit point (small-AOE); physical -> no element family, stun is the native physical-heavy-hit ailment substrate. The damage engine is the Trauma self-damage accumulator, not the strike geometry

bow shot that ground-targets; on impact deploys a large caustic cloud that ticks chaos DoT — the cloud IS the primary damage zone, the arrow hit is incidental (build ignores accuracy/crit). chaos -> shadow (corruption/chaos-DoT lineage); the cloud is a ground_targeted_circle DoT. Volley adds overlapping clouds in a fan

channel projects a steerable illusion-of-self that travels the cursor path at 130% move speed emitting NON-OVERLAPPING pulse damage along a lane, accruing stages; on channel-release the player TELEPORTS to the illusion and delivers a stage-scaled burst. dash_attack captures the reposition-strike but is movement-primary; the steerable-phantom + path-pulses + snap-teleport is a compound this base type flattens

swing weapon(s) in a 180-degree frontal arc damaging everything in front; dual-wield hits 60% per weapon combined. melee_arc is the purpose-built 'wide frontal melee swing' type — a lossless fit. physical -> no element family; bleed is the native physical-swing ailment substrate. base radius 20u -> +1m at gem 20 is a numeric range

channel-move spin whose ONLY job here is to generate attack CRITS as fast as possible; whirlwind is the spin host body. physical/no-family; deals no meaningful damage itself in this build — it is the trigger engine's crank

nova expands from player position on each crit-trigger; multiple Novas per Cyclone revolution blanket a large zone. ring = burst-around-self; cold -> water family; chill/freeze native cold ailments. Frostbolt interaction lets Ice Nova cast at Frostbolt positions (secondary geometry seed)

instant-cast cold pool centered at/beneath the player; ticks cold DoT and chills. ground_targeted_circle = the pool; cold -> water; chill native. The instant-cast-at-feet no-travel is the safety identity
projectile that deploys a cold cloud at the target for single-target coverage; another ground_targeted_circle DoT pool. Frostbolt (not core-damage) seeds Creeping-Frost positions in some variants

forward lightning beam with smaller beams branching off at an angle to hit enemies to the sides. beam_channel = the forward beam; lightning family; PoE shock -> sunder (damage-taken amp, FALSE-FRIEND handled). Intensity RESHAPES the geometry (wide-branching -> narrow-forward), which the base type cannot express

the automation primitive: a self-damage HIT crosses the CwDT threshold and triggers linked spells from self-position. self_buff placeholder for the trigger-carrier; the trigger IS the kit, not a targeted geometry. depth-1 primitive is native; the CLOSED LOOP is not

triggered area spell that radiates from the player AND deals more self-damage, feeding the next CwDT. chaos -> shadow; ring = self-radiating burst. The consequence re-triggering the cause is the depth>1 collision

channel-move spin dealing weapon hits in a radius while walking freely through packs; whirlwind is the purpose-built '360-degree spin = radial melee AoE' type — a lossless fit. physical -> no element family; full-movement-during-channel is native to whirlwind. leech sustains from physical hits

chaos nova that originates at a skeleton and CHAINS between skeletons (>=3 present), each hop a fresh nova; SACRIFICES skeleton max-life as the damage fuel (or the player's own life if no skeletons). chain geometry; chaos -> shadow; drain carries the life-sacrifice-as-damage register. Note: engine chain DECAYS 0.7x/hop (arc precedent)

populate the field with skeleton minions whose MAX LIFE is the ammo pool Dark Pact spends; totem = placed proxy entities. They are NOT autonomous attackers here — they are consumable batteries, dying rapidly and needing constant resummon

small-radius aura ring radiating from the walking body; constant chaos DoT to all enemies within radius; no projectile, no directional cast, zero button presses. chaos->shadow (crosswalk §1 chaos = drain-DoT lineage). The chaos DoT is a life-decay tick -> drain ailment (§2 life-drain/decay/chaos-DoT -> drain), NOT poison (this is a reserved-aura DoT field, not a stacking-venom skill)

targeted cast on a corpse at location; small AoE (2.2m->2.6m at gem 20) fire explosion; explosion damage = 6-7.9% of the CORPSE's maximum life (scales with the VICTIM's body, not caster stats); Ignite procs -> burn DoT. Blackflame ring can convert the ignite to chaos in the 3.22+ meta but the base identity is fire

corpse-spawning spell: places a patch of corpses at target location as ammunition for Detonate Dead. A support/feeder cast (spawns the ammo substrate), not a damage geometry — ground_targeted_circle as the corpse-placement footprint

self-origin nova burst around the player body; consumes ALL accumulated charges at once, damage scaled per charge consumed; large-zone footprint. Multi-element by charge TYPE: lightning per power charge, fire per endurance charge, cold per frenzy charge — top-2 by build weight kept (fire endurance + lightning power); the ignite variant (probe 'burn', mech_note fire) is the reference build so fire leads. ring = burst-around-self (§6 nova->ring)

channel gathers charge by zapping nearby enemies (accumulating up to 10 stages), then on release fires a screen-length forward annihilation beam along the lane axis (fixed length, cannot be area-scaled) plus a damage bubble from the player on release; rooted while channeling. shock (PoE damage-amp) -> sunder (false-friend, §2). beam_channel = the channel+beam identity

Ballista Totems (placed autonomous proxies) fire Explosive Arrows that stick to the target and stack fuses (up to 20); when the fuse-stack detonates it produces one massive fire AoE ignite. The DOMINANT loop is totem-delivered (player runs free while totems work) -> totem geometry (§6 totem/sentry/turret = placed autonomous proxy). The detonation itself is a ground_targeted_circle burst at the target (secondary geometry, noted in scaffold)

at-target melee slam; immediate AoE hit covers the base area, then after a short delay an aftershock fires a LARGER-radius second hit at the same location (150% more damage). PHYSICAL RULE: physical melee -> element-neutral (element carries flavor only); identity via geometry (ground_slam = slam/quake, §6) + stun (heavy physical slam). The delayed aftershock is a native `delayed` timing primitive (delay_seconds)

at-target slam that sends 5 rectangular fissures from the slam point; spikes erupt at fissure endpoints (max 15-18 simultaneous, 6s duration). The spikes are inert until DETONATED by a warcry (or a follow-up slam), which shatters all nearby spikes for a large-zone AoE. Two-step plant-then-detonate. PHYSICAL RULE -> element-neutral; ground_slam = the slam/quake geometry (§6). The plant->warcry-detonate is a mark-apply/consume pair

the detonation trigger: a warcry shatters all planted spikes AND grants Rage (Berserker War Bringer keystone). self_buff = the warcry's self-centered buff+detonate pulse; it is the consume half of the plant-then-detonate loop, not an offensive geometry itself

a single projectile fired from player to target that applies a heavy chaos DoT debuff on hit (AoE radius 8 at the hit). chaos->shadow (§1 chaos = drain-DoT lineage); the chaos DoT = drain ailment (§2 essence-drain/decay -> drain, the literal namesake). Modeled multi_projectile as the fired-bolt delivery (single bolt; the DoT is the payload)

AoE chaos debuff zone cast on a pack; its function is the SPREAD engine — when a Contagion-debuffed enemy DIES, the Essence Drain DoT jumps to nearby living enemies (chain-hop room-clear). ground_targeted_circle = the placed debuff-zone footprint; the on-death spread is trigger-grammar

bow attack: a projectile to the target with a small AoE burst at impact (ranged, bow range). Each attack rolls ONE random element (fire/cold/lightning) at large values; Combat Focus threshold jewels DELETE unwanted elements (block cold, block lightning) to FORCE a single-element roll. Mapped element_primary=fire = the forced-fire meta play (the reference build); burn = the fire-ignite. multi_projectile = the bow-shot delivery

unarmed direct melee strike on the target with a small melee-splash AoE; on kill, explodes the corpse for a small fire AoE. PHYSICAL RULE: unarmed physical -> element-neutral (the Facebreaker gloves multiply PHYSICAL unarmed damage; element is flavor). melee_strike = single-target unarmed hit (§6). stun = the heavy-physical-punch archetype; corpse-explode-on-kill is a rider (on-defender-death)

a placed ancestor totem that slams and grants the player an on-hit melee-damage buff while active. totem geometry (§6 totem/sentry); a support proxy that buffs the unarmed punches, not the dominant offense itself

thrown to a target ground location where it ARMS; when an enemy steps near (proximity), it erupts for a fire hit (can ignite) AND leaves a burning-ground DoT patch persisting ~3s. fire->burn. ground_targeted_circle = the thrown-to-ground eruption + persistent burning-ground patch (§6 pool/patch/ground-DoT). The proximity-arm-then-erupt is a trap behavioral property (deploy-and-bait)

channel from the player's own position to grow a circle through up to 10 stages (base 2m radius, +0.3m/stage = 5m max; 165% more spell damage per stage); release at full size for an enormous fire nova; rooted while channeling, earlier release = smaller zone + less damage. fire->burn. circle = the expanding self-origin circle (§6 expanding circle); it grows from self so circle (not ring) is the honest type for the filled expanding nova

teleport-strike: the player vanishes and reappears in melee range of a nearby enemy AND lands the hit in one action, then auto-repeats target-to-target while Frenzy Charges last. Physical melee -> element-neutral (physical rule; elem_raw=physical is flavor only). Engine's own derivation rule (physical + teleport-effect -> dash_attack) corroborates dash_attack over teleport (which is the non-physical reposition member). The 'random nearby target each hop' auto-chaining is a behavioral property of the repeated dash, not a distinct 26-geometry

lobs an exploding chaos projectile at the target location AND fires 6-7 homing projectiles at surrounding enemies; the payload is a chaos-damage HIT (scaled off the caster's life+ES), not a DoT -> no signature ailment (control centrality=none). shadow family (chaos hit lineage). The nova+seeking-projectile spread reads as multi_projectile (the exploding-lob is the dominant many-projectile footprint)

Hierophant plants 5-7 totems that each CAST Forbidden Rite; the totem is the autonomous proxy that fires the spell. The player positions behind the totem line for coverage. totem = placed autonomous caster-proxy

an icy projectile that PIERCES all enemies in a straight line and loses damage + freeze-chance the farther it travels (up to 50% less damage, freeze-chance gone after the first quarter of flight). line = straight-line piercing axis. water/cold family; chill (soft slow) + freeze (hard lock, native shatter payoff). The inverse 'closer = more damage / more freeze' decay is a behavioral property with no geometry-enum carrier

a cold melee strike on the targeted enemy with increased range; this primary hit is the every-3-sec dominant action. water/cold family; chill+freeze (native shatter payoff). Physical base but the build scales as a COLD attack (100% convert)

on the primary melee hit, releases a fan of 5-8 icy projectiles that fly at enemies BEHIND the first target (dealing 30% less than the strike). multi_projectile = the icy-blade fan; this is the clear/AoE half of the skill spawned by the melee hit

a warcry (3s cooldown) that consumes nearby CORPSES to summon Mirage Warriors (2 corpses per 5 Power, up to ~5-6); the cry itself is a self-origin proc-trigger, not damage. self_buff = the warcry activation handle; the summoned warriors carry the offense

each Mirage Warrior spawns at a corpse position and immediately performs ONE exerted cast of the player's LINKED strike skill (e.g. Blade Flurry/Cyclone/Boneshatter), then vanishes. Transient melee proxy executing a linked-cast. melee_arc = the wide frontal strike the linked skill typically delivers; physical melee -> element-neutral (flavor); bleed is the common linked-skill ailment rider

on mine detonation, icicles erupt from the ground in a SERIES OF 4 BURSTS MARCHING FORWARD in a line, each knocking enemies toward the next burst; final burst deals 200% more damage with 100% more radius. line = the forward-marching lane of sequential eruptions (the dominant footprint); water/cold; chill+freeze (native shatter) + knockback (each burst shoves toward the next)

a single-target melee strike (mace/sceptre) that converts 100% of physical damage to COLD; every 3rd successive hit carries a large (200-390%) more-damage bonus; frozen non-unique enemies below 1/3 life SHATTER when hit. melee_strike = the point single-target hit; water/cold family (full phys->cold conversion); chill+freeze with the engine's native shatter-at-freeze-expiry-under-threshold payoff -- a direct match to the skill's shatter-frozen-low-life mechanic

skill_geometry_band.source_skill: Summon Flame Golem (primary damage proxy, x4)
skill_geometry_band.source_anchor: 4 Flame Golems are the entire damage engine; each is an autonomous proxy casting fire spray / fire wave / explosive arcing projectile in its own area, scaled almost entirely by Primordial Harmony jewels (cooldown resets). totem = placed autonomous proxy entity; fire family + burn (ignite rider)

one each of Ice/Lightning/Stone/(Chaos) Golem summoned NOT for damage but for the aura-buffs they grant while alive (Primordial Eminence = Golem Effectiveness: damage/life-regen/phys-reduction to the whole menagerie). Support-proxies whose value is the network buff, not their attacks

a forceful single-target melee blow (mace/axe/sword/staff); the build stacks ~75% reduced-enemy-stun-threshold so nearly every hit STUNS, and damage scales off the stun model. melee_strike = single-target point hit; physical -> element-neutral (physical rule); stun is the identity ailment + chill (the 3.23 'Stun and Chill' Champion variant adds cold). Delivery/econ confidence is LOW (post-cutoff 3.28 kit, sparse sources)

on mine detonation, Hexblast deals a huge CHAOS hit to the target that is massively amplified IF the target is Hexed, then REMOVES (consumes) the hex; only when a hex is consumed does the damage spread as AoE (3.2m) to nearby enemies. circle = the small AoE burst at the target on hex-consume; shadow (chaos hit); the curse it consumes is the amplify-class hex (Despair etc.). The consume-the-curse-for-a-crit IS the identity

summons an Agony Crawler minion (proxy) that uses projectile and area attacks and does ALL the killing; its attack speed and damage scale off the player's Virulence stack count (max 40); the crawler DIES if Virulence hits 0. totem = the autonomous placed proxy; shadow (chaos) family + poison (the damage register). The proxy is the entire offense

the player spins with Cyclone (or Caustic Arrow) purely to POISON enemies rapidly; each poison inflicted grants a Virulence stack that feeds the crawler. whirlwind = the Cyclone spin; the player's hits do ~no killing, they only build virulence. Ball Lightning is a common secondary poison-applier

fires an arrow that converts some physical to cold ON the target, then converts ALL physical to cold in a CONE BEHIND that target at impact (base radius 2.4m); the cone-splash-behind-the-target is the identity-bearing AoE and the dominant clear footprint. cone = the impact splash; water/cold family; chill+freeze (native shatter). The arrow itself is the delivery vector into the cone

each detonated mine fires 5 icicle projectiles outward in a circle from its position; with a field of mines the volleys CONVERGE on the pack from multiple placements; fires +1 additional projectile per 2 prior mines in the detonation sequence; projectiles dissipate quickly (short effective range). water/cold; chill+freeze (native shatter payoff)

channeled flamethrower held on the aim direction: flames spread wider close to you and longer directly in front (a cone-shaped footprint riding a channel spine); stages ramp to 8 (25% more damage per stage; cone angle +100% per stage up to 300%), releasing at max stages fires a final wave at 500% more damage. beam_channel = the channel-maintain delivery; cone is the noted footprint alternative (s7.2)

wand volley: up to 12 projectiles accumulate hovering around the character, then fire sequentially (0.05s apart) at nearby enemies, exploding on impact; each projectile deals MORE damage per prior projectile fired in the sequence; +3 base chains extend each bolt. Pure-physical wand attack -> element-neutral (physical rule; elem_raw=physical is flavor only); no attested ailment centrality (probe control empty)

two consecutive wide slashes -- one to the left, then the right -- sending waves of force in cone areas (base radius 38 units); enemies positioned in the OVERLAP zone take damage from BOTH hits; Blood Stance loads the bleed (25% chance; up to 88% increased damage vs bleeding). Pure-physical melee -> element-neutral (physical rule); bleed IS the identity ailment

persistent stance toggle, no damage of its own: Blood Stance = bleed-damage mode (single-target lean); Sand Stance = +50% slash angle (clear lean). The stance RE-TUNES Lacerate; modeled as the toggle handle

bow projectile; on hit, a lightning bolt ALSO strikes up to 3 additional enemies within 18 units of the target -- a one-hop SIMULTANEOUS splash-fan modeled as chain (the arrow delivery spine is folded into this note per b04 ice-shot composite precedent); 50% phys->lightning conversion; PoE shock -> engine sunder (damage-taken amp; s2 FALSE FRIEND, engine shock is paralysis CC)

6-metre base-radius area at the cast position: strikes ALL shocked enemies in the area simultaneously and REMOVES their shock -- (10-20)% more damage per 5% shock effect consumed; spiky burst payoff (amp_val=spiky corroborates). PoE shock -> sunder (s2 false friend); the consume event is modeled in trigger grammar

placed storm-orb sentry that periodically zaps nearby enemies to APPLY the sunder that Conduit cashes in; totem = the placed-autonomous-caster 26-type. NOT the R-M6 drift-tick class (Orb of Storms is stationary; R-M6 circle ruling covers Ball-Lightning slow-travel orbs, not this)
the primary melee swing on the targeted enemy -- the every-3-seconds dominant action; 50% phys->lightning conversion; applies the shock (-> sunder, s2 false friend). Leads per s7.2

on the melee hit, 3 base projectiles (quality adds up to 1) shoot FORWARD in a ~85-degree arc, traveling straight until they strike an enemy; 50% less damage than the strike but cannot miss if the melee connects. The ranged-clear half spawned by the hit

the kit's 'skill' is the RESERVATION FRAME itself: stack multiple auras reserving life (not mana) until the character sits permanently below the 35% Low Life threshold; the auras are the payload the freed reservation buys. aura = the persistent self-radius presence type

skill_geometry_band.source_skill: era-variable damage spell (LL RF / LL Spark)
skill_geometry_band.source_anchor: the damage slot is ERA-VARIABLE (Righteous Fire self-burn zone, Spark, etc.) -- the Shavronne's + Pain Attunement frame is the constant, per the verified variants record; mapped representatively as the fire-register large-zone spell the corpus row carries (elem_raw=fire, geo_raw=large-AOE), circle = its expanding-zone footprint

ethereal blades spin around the caster for 4s each, up to 10 active, repeatedly damaging enemies they pass through -- orbit is the NATIVE 26-type for exactly this (Wave-C R8-orbit; poe1-poison-bv/vaal-blade-vortex are its named engine exemplars). On each cast, Minion Pact SACRIFICES a random nearby damageable minion and adds physical damage equal to (2-2.8)% (up to ~5.4% scaled) of the sacrificed minion's life. Pure-physical -> element-neutral (physical rule); no ailment centrality attested

high-life Spectres raised NOT to fight but to be eaten: the re-raise loop keeps sacrifice fuel standing near the caster. totem = the placed-proxy 26-type; the non-combat feedstock role is the noted deviation

the hammer swing on the target -- the every-swing dominant action; each HIT triggers a socketed lightning spell (0.25s internal cooldown; raised from 0.15s at 3.17); triggered spells cost 0. The swing itself is the trigger host; lightning flavor rides the payload; shock -> sunder (s2 false friend)

the auto-cast lightning spell pouring out of the swings: Arc = chain (geo_raw corroborates; +1 chain from the item; engine chain decays 0.7x/hop while Arc grows per remaining chain -- arc-b01 audit drift, inherited here). Ball Lightning alternative = circle per R-M6 drift-tick ruling (do not re-decide); Arc mapped as the primary payload per core_skills order

the primary melee swing on the targeted enemy -- 60% phys->fire conversion; the every-3-seconds dominant action; leads per s7.2. Since 3.7, projectiles ONLY spawn on a connecting hit (whiff spawns nothing)

on the hit, 4 base magma-ball projectiles launch in varied directions, travel 2-25 units, and land SIMULTANEOUSLY, each hitting a circular splash area around its landing point (60% less damage per ball); against a big single target the balls OVERLAP on it -- the boss-shotgun identity

UNARMED flask-thrower: lob an exploding poison vial in a thrown arc to the targeted point; 1.8-metre base blast radius at landing; 40% chance to poison (stacking chaos DoT); consumes 1 Life-Flask charge per projectile if available, and adds chaos damage equal to 4-16% of that flask's recovery amount. ground_targeted_circle = the lob-to-point blast; chaos-POISON kit -> earth family (s1 poison row: venom/alchemical register -- Pathfinder nature-flask lineage; shadow alternative noted), ailment lane = poison either way

charged detonation: the totem channels stages 1-10, the blast circle GROWS from 2m base +3m per stage, then detonates one big fire burst (spiky amp). Expanding circle -> circle (crosswalk section-6 exemplar). The live stage->radius growth is behavioral (see mint accrual)

placed proxy that performs the channel FOR the player — the channel commitment is outsourced; 2-4 totems clustered (the 'pizza sticks' minimap visual); Ancestral Bond frame: the player deals no damage, ever

consumes nearby corpses -> spawns seeking fire orbs (up to ~3 per cast, one per corpse) that roll toward nearby enemies and detonate in a larger circle on contact ('creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area'). Multi-orb spawn -> multi_projectile; the roll-seek locomotion + detonation circle are behavioral notes
bone projectile dealing phys that SEEDS a corpse at impact — the ammo-supplier half of the corpse pair; physical -> element-neutral (physical rule)
the ONE button: each wand attack generates a frenzy charge (attack-speed ramp) and trips both socketed spells via the wands' trigger; physical attack -> element-neutral

recast to stack up to 10 ethereal blades ORBITING the body; more blades = higher hit frequency against everything in the orbit radius ('blades now increase the frequency at which all enemies in the radius take damage'); walk into packs — phys-to-chaos poison stacking on every hit

stores a fraction of poison damage dealt into a plague pool while incubating, then toggles to release: an aura that burns the stored pool as chaos DoT around the player while active — store-then-spend

summons ONE persistent slashing shadow-beast proxy that auto-fights with 'a variety of slashing area attacks' near its position; RECAST = command: it dashes to the targeted location and performs a powerful attack; gains 30% increased AoE when it has consumed other minions. Physical -> element-neutral (physical rule); no ailment attested (probe facts absent, dossier silent)

toggle self-immolation: constant fire DoT in a small radius (base 1.8-2.3m, gem-scaled) around the walking body; costs the caster's own life per second; sustained by out-regenerating the self-burn — activate once per zone, never press it again
the boss/single-target supplement and the only button the build actually presses: thrown eruption + burning-ground patch (b03 fire-trap geometry convention)

CHANNEL to grow thorn stages 1-5 (commit=channel); release fires the arrow, which leaves spore pods in its wake; each pod blooms a fan of 9 short-range thorn arrows; overlapping fans shotgun poison stacks at close range. Volley/fan -> multi_projectile; the pod-line staging is the approximated part

thrown trap arms at the target location; on trigger releases 5 shockwave WAVES, one every 0.9s over 3.5s; each wave = a series of small bursts in a line ending with a larger burst, AoE radius 12; stacking traps overlaps the pulse grids into a boss-melting hammering zone. Shockwave/quake -> ground_slam (section-6); physical -> element-neutral

second trap thrown for map clear; the dossier attests only its trap-delivery role — geometry beyond at-target placement is UNATTESTED, mapped from probe delivery (at-target) + the trap chassis only (no-fabrication law); physical -> element-neutral

places ballista turret proxies that auto-fire piercing bolts (pierce 6 targets at gem level 1 up to 9 at 20) at range; with Iron Commander the maximum ballista count scales with stacked DEX (+1 per 200) — the battery fires in parallel from placed positions. Physical -> element-neutral (physical rule)

summons a squad of skeleton MAGES — each casts ranged elemental bolt projectiles from formation, firing independently (multi-point army delivery); bolts pierce; Sniper's Mark splits projectiles; resummon as they expire. Per-mage bolt = single_target; the army-parallelism lives in the proxy frame

single HOMING chaos projectile that turns toward enemies in front of it, PIERCES everything it passes, repeatedly applies a short powerful chaos DoT to each enemy in an area around it, and leeches spell damage as energy shield (4% attested) while traveling. door_registry.description: Trades a defensive stat for offensive power (or vice-versa).
Spawns proxy clones that mirror the caster's skills from their own spatial origins.
Trigger-family door: a host action triggers a payload skill (e.g. Cast-on-Crit).
Converts a skill's damage to a single target element.
Converts a skill's damage to/from physical.
Collapses delivery geometry (e.g. shotgun-density / burst-around-self).
Propagates delivery geometry across the pack (chain/fork/cascade family).
Cascade variant: geometry propagates in a forward-marching cascade.
Momentum/build-up that cascades into escalating output.
Amplifies via a network of linked effects (brands/links).
Sustains a persistent effect while a resource/summon is active.
Persistence via saturating overlapping zones/DoTs.
Sustains a defensive/utility effect while a resource/summon is active.
Movement/phase momentum that powers the loop.
Places autonomous emitter proxies (totem lane) that act on their own.
Many proxies converge fire on a point/target.
Splits into many small proxies/minions (fission).
Inverts the proxy relationship (host becomes proxy or vice-versa).
A dominant proxy governs subordinate proxies.
Self-reinforcing resonance loop (trigger feeds itself).
Converts one resource into another (life-as-mana, etc.).
Reactive retribution (damage returned on being hit/blocking).
Self-sacrifice/self-damage as the power source.
Accumulate-then-discharge charge economy (build stack, dump stack).
Controls/denies a zone of the battlefield.

Projectile lobs on a ballistic arc to a target point.
Effect orbits a fixed point (player or anchor).
Single-point melee/slam impact at the targeted enemy/ground.
Projectile travels a straight vector from origin.
Effect sweeps as a wall/line across an area.
